projects.title: Duo Git
projects.description: GitHub shows contribution data with no emotional dimension, and most gamification fills that gap by punishing absence — a broken streak becomes a reason to quit rather than to return. DuoGit makes inactivity recoverable instead of shameful: a mascot moves through four states that acknowledge a gap without judging it, and streak recovery is built into the loop. Nine screens, a full widget family for iOS and Android, league ranking and XP mechanics, measured against behavioral KPIs — streak recovery rate, Day 7 retention, time-to-first-commit.

projects.title: Cuak
projects.description: Banking apps show balance, limit and due date but never answer the question users actually have: am I okay? Cuak promotes the emotional state to primary interface — a 60/40 layout gives objective data the left side and the mascot the right, and a purchase simulator advises before the money is spent rather than reporting after. Validated in prototype testing: five of five testers reported feeling more in control with mascot feedback than with the same number shown alone.
